speaker.aurelith.description: A young queen in her mid-twenties: a clear, warm mezzo-soprano voice with quiet authority, compassionate yet fierce and certain, a hint of pride. Regal but not cold, youthful and alive, never breathy. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.

speaker.hollow-raider.description: A battle-scarred male warrior survivor in his thirties: a deep, gruff, low voice, grim and resolute, few words, grief held back by anger and duty. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.

speaker.kesh.description: A male patrol leader in his late twenties, the older brother: a steady, warm baritone with a slight rasp, worn out and hurt but proud, calm under pressure, deeply relieved to be found. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.

speaker.mother-ashka.description: An ancient matron who was once warm and motherly, now changed and lost in a dream: an old woman's low, cracked voice, rasping and wet, drifting between whispers and sudden loud cries, dazed and haunted, as if hearing a song no one else can hear. Slow, uneven, unsettling but sad rather than evil. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.

speaker.narrator.description: A wise elderly woman narrator: deep, rich and velvety, calm and a little solemn, with long pauses and a hint of mystery in her voice. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, clearly and unhurried, close to the microphone in a quiet room, as if telling a tale to children by lantern light.

speaker.needler.description: A young female archer and sharpshooter in her twenties: a cool, focused, slightly husky mezzo voice, precise and dry-humoured, quiet confidence, speaks low as if not to give away her position. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy strategy game.

speaker.nurse-ardi.description: A middle-aged nurse of a ruined colony, about fifty: a soft, gentle alto voice, kind and motherly, exhausted, frightened and grieving, trembling slightly, speaking quietly as if still afraid to be heard. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.

speaker.tiv.description: A young male scout of about eighteen: a light, bright tenor voice, quick and eager, loyal and earnest, a little breathless from running, nervous energy he tries to hide in front of his queen. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
